verdict.rationale: Open WebUI documents running one agent per workspace, all supervised in parallel from one tab (docs-36). Each workspace is exposed as its own OpenAI-compatible model (docs-33), and custom agents appear as selectable models in the chat sidebar (docs-26), so conversations can be pointed at a specific agent. Channels let multiple models take part in shared timelines (docs-9, docs-54), workspaces pick up their own skills and AGENTS.md instructions (docs-57), and parallel sub-agents can be delegated to (docs-58). Missing for 10: explicit docs on per-agent system-prompt and model configuration, documented rules for routing a channel to a specific agent, and independent hands-on corroboration of multi-agent setups.
